messages:
emma-partner: Quick sync request — Marketplace asked for a private-offer structure to accelerate on-prem -> marketplace migrations. I'm proposing a 'surge buffer' credit: an upfront consumption credit equivalent to 3 months of their historical monthly usage if they sign a 12-month private offer at >=80% of prior 12mo spend. Need SI + HW + legal input before we pitch co-announcement.

carlos-gpm: I like the nudge mechanics. Two quick asks: 1) can we make the credit cliff after 60 days if usage doesn't ramp? 2) SKU mapping for appliances -> marketplace SKUs so finance can do revenue recognition.

sarah-revops: cliff is reasonable. For reporting we need "committed consumption baseline" defined (avg last 6mo vs last 12mo?). Also, need a way to track if the credit was used or reclaimed. Suggest tracking via a private-offer metadata tag + billing meter: `surge_buffer_{offer_id}`.

mike-legal: Heads-up on two risk items: (a) we should avoid language that implies guaranteed performance from HW/SI partners, (b) clawback terms need to be explicit — e.g., prorated repayment if they terminate early. I'll draft a short addendum.

anita-sales: From field POV, customers love a time-bounded credit. If we set the cliff at 60 days, reps will ask for visibility into the conversion funnel we expect. Can we model expected lift? If we tell them "~30% lift in months 1-3" and we miss, it'll be a mess. Better to use conservative language. Also, SI partners will want co-funding on top of the credit for migrations — can we offer a joint SI success rebate instead of direct credit in some deals?

marketplace-bot: New doc uploaded: https://redwood-internal.docs/sales/marketplace/surge-buffer-proposal (access: partners-only).

carlos-gpm: Here's a quick terms sketch (feel free to tweak):
```
{
  "offer_term": "12 months private-offer",
  "commit_threshold": ">=80% prior-12mo-spend",
  "surge_buffer": "3x average monthly usage (credit applied month 1-3)",
  "cliff_check": "day 60: if monthly usage < 50% baseline => credit reclaimed prorated",
  "si_rebate_option": "up to 10% of credit value paid to SI after verified migration"
}
```

emma-partner: Thanks Carlos — that JSON is perfect for an internal rubric. Two follow-ups: (1) can Eng-Platform estimate the billing tag work and latency for adding `surge_buffer_{offer_id}`? (2) PM: can we set a tentative co-announcement window that's >45 days after offer activation to give SIs time?

anita-sales: For co-announcement timing, partners prefer 6-8 weeks post-activation to confirm migration stories. 45 days is tight. Recommend 8 weeks. Also request a partner-facing FAQ template for common Qs (billing, renewal, hardware trade-in).

mike-legal: I'll prepare a short addendum + a one-paragraph FAQ blurb on clawbacks and termination.

emma-partner: Action items: 
- Mike: draft addendum by EOD Wed 
- Carlos: finalize terms JSON and SKU mapping list 
- Sarah: define tracking metric + reporting query for `surge_buffer` tag 
- Anita: confirm SI participation list and co-funding asks by next Tue 
- Marketplace (cc @marketplace-bot): flag any listing gating or review lead times >2w

anita-sales: :thumbsup: will start outreach.

carlos-gpm: Happy to own SKU mapping. I'll ping infra for a quick script to translate appliance SKUs -> marketplace SKUs.

emma-partner: Great — if no objections by EOD I'll schedule a 30m sync with SI leads + marketplace ops next week. Thanks all.
